notes: The Drowned Atlas: single-file story RPG in Siltmarsh. 3 chapters, 7 districts, 4 interacting systems (dialogue/trust, daylight/tide time pressure, survey/craft charts, journal/discoveries), 5 endings, save/load via localStorage, synthesised WebAudio music/SFX, responsive parchment chart-table UI with keyboard shortcuts (1-7,S,H,C,J,Esc), WCAG-focused labels/focus/reduced-motion/large-text. Single ~54KB HTML, no external assets/build/network. Performance: DOM-only map (7 nodes), no per-frame loops except 1.4s music timer, renders on state change only. Verified in Chromium from file:// after fixes: cold title, game visible (display block), map nodes sized/no overlap/no horizontal overflow, automated full playthrough Day1-3 through all 3 crafts to finished ending + credits, ending gating (shared/honest/ordered/hidden/narrow), mid-game and finished save/load coherence, pause/settings/help, keyboard travel/locking, corrupted/huge save clamping, rapid-input single-spend — 0 console errors in final runs. Screenshot capture unavailable (needs visible desktop window), so visual check was via live DOM geometry, not pixels.
